# Vashon-Maury Island Beachcomber

> > Community newspaper serving Vashon and Maury Islands in Washington State with local news, events, and island information.

The Vashon-Maury Island Beachcomber is a local newspaper published by Sound Publishing, covering news, events, and community stories for residents of Vashon and Maury Islands. The publication is staffed by journalists including Daralyn Anderson, Alex Bruell, Elizabeth Shepherd, and Jennifer Tribbett, and is part of the Carpenter Media Group network.
